verdict.rationale: Greptile documents automatic review of every PR. It can detect agent-authored PRs and route them to a different model for cross-model review, and coding agents can run its CLI to review their own code. Volume is addressed by a parallel agent swarm and horizontally scaled Kubernetes deployments, and one community user reports it catches real issues before human review. Missing for 10: quantitative or independent evidence of review throughput at agent-scale volume, and independent corroboration of the agent-authored PR detection and routing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer holds the line on AI-generated PRs — it verifies agent-authored code at a volume no human team could review

citations.quote: Greptile is an AI code review agent that automatically reviews every pull request with complete understanding of your codebase.
Greptile can now detect when a PR was authored by a coding agent and route the review to a different model. If Claude wrote it, GPT reviews it, and if GPT wrote it, Claude reviews it.
Coding agents can use the greptile cli to review their own code
v5 is faster, catches more bugs, and flags fewer false positives by running a swarm of narrowly scoped agents in parallel.
Kubernetes: 100+ developers. Horizontal scaling, high availability.
more often than not it catches real issues and gives the author a chance to reply or fix them before another human reviews the PR.
